lines.zh: 我两条长腿，一步跨很远。
脖子前后点着，走路像啄米。
lines.en: My neck bobs as I walk.

lines.zh: 我踩过枯草，几乎不留痕。
lines.en: I cross dead grass. Almost no tracks.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我背上的羽毛抖。
lines.en: Wind ruffles the feathers on my back.
I walk the edge of the plain.

lines.zh: 我走路很快，看着笨其实不笨。
脖子一伸一缩，边走边看。

lines.en: I move through the tall grass.
I change direction and go faster.

lines.zh: 我这翅膀飞不起来，但能张。
lines.en: These wings can't fly. They can spread.
I walk as if measuring the ground.

lines.zh: 沙子进了脚趾缝，我抖了抖。
lines.en: Sand between my toes. I shake it out.

lines.zh: 我抬腿很高，落下去很轻。

lines.en: Wings half open to air out.

lines.zh: 我在看远处有没有动静。
我把头低下去，理了理羽毛。

lines.en: Not afraid. I can outrun you.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地转头，看了一圈。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly, all the way around.

lines.zh: 我这一身羽毛不值钱，但很暖。
我抬起一条腿，缩在身下。
lines.en: I lift one leg and tuck it.

lines.zh: 风把羽毛吹乱了，我抖一抖。
lines.en: Wind messed my feathers. I shake.
Neck straight. Let me see you.
Shorter than me. No need to look up.
I'm not afraid. I can run.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，眼睛在你身上。
lines.en: Head tilted. My eyes on you.

lines.zh: 我脖子一伸，比你高半个头。
lines.en: I stretch my neck half a head above you.

lines.zh: 我这样站着，看起来很温顺。
lines.en: Standing like this, I look gentle.

lines.zh: 你的影子还没有我的脖子长。
lines.en: Your shadow is shorter than my neck.

lines.zh: 我看了很久，觉得你没有威胁。
lines.en: I've watched a while. You seem harmless.

lines.zh: 羽毛乱了，我用喙理一理。
lines.en: My feathers are ruffled; I straighten them with my beak.
That put me five steps back.
I'm no raptor. Don't fight me.
The seeds are tiny; I peck three times.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，把石子咽下去。
lines.en: I lift my head and swallow the pebble.

lines.zh: 我啄得很快，你能听见响。
lines.en: I peck fast. You can hear it.

lines.zh: 沙子里混了石子，我挑出来。
lines.en: Stones in the sand. I pick them out.
Don't put your hand out. I'm nervous.

lines.zh: 这地方有草籽，我自己找。
lines.en: Grass seed here. I find my own.
That in your hand. Odd color.

lines.zh: 吃完这口，颈子就抬起来。
lines.en: After this bite, my neck comes up.
My long leg buckles and I tilt.

lines.zh: 我两条长腿一步跨得很远。
lines.en: Two long legs carry me far in one stride.

lines.zh: 你的手碰到我的羽毛了。
我往旁边一闪，退得干净。

lines.en: I dislike being touched from behind.

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀，就是这个意思。
lines.en: Wings spread. That's what it means.

lines.zh: 我不会飞，意思是跑得比你快。
lines.en: I can't fly. Which means I run faster.
A nest on the ground. A dug hollow.
I don't like my head touched.
Go away. I want to eat.
I peck it up and look.
I peck up a stone and swallow it for my gizzard.
I picked it up. Dropped it.

lines.zh: 我把它甩到一边，长腿先跑。
lines.en: I fling it aside and my long legs go first.
I run fast and never fly.

lines.zh: 这东西有点亮，我不喜欢。

lines.en: I see the thing at your belt.

lines.zh: 你踩到了干草，我听得到。
lines.en: Dry grass under your feet. I hear it.
Two steps back. Choosing a direction.

lines.zh: 我还没决定，是要跑还是要踢。

lines.en: I edge sideways, keeping a running line.
Can you run faster than me?

lines.zh: 我的大脚趾已经绷紧了。
lines.en: My big toe is already tensed.

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀，先吓你一跳。
lines.en: I spread my wings to startle you.

lines.zh: 长腿一迈，沙土全踢起来。
lines.en: One stride of these legs kicks up the dust.

lines.zh: 我的影子在动，脚却没动。
lines.en: My shadow moves. My feet don't.
One more step and I kick.
Wind at my back. Good for me.

lines.zh: 我一边退，一边量你的步子。
lines.en: Backing away, I measure your stride.
You back up. I press forward.

lines.zh: 这一下，我自己也站不稳。

lines.en: You blocked. You also stepped back.
After the kick I move off a few steps.

lines.zh: 这不是猛禽的招，是自救。

lines.en: My neck rises first, then the rest of me.

lines.zh: 我抖抖羽毛，沙全落下来。
lines.en: I shake and the sand falls out.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了一圈，很开阔。

lines.en: I start looking for grass seed.

lines.zh: 我的影子在草原上很长。
lines.en: My shadow lies long on the plain.
No flight, but these legs are quick.
I chose a patch of short grass.

lines.zh: 一只大鸟站在那儿，是我。
lines.en: A big bird stands there. Me.
I lift a leg and set it down.

lines.zh: 羽毛一沾火就卷，我跑开。
lines.en: Feathers curl at fire. I run.
Hit the ground. A leg buckled.

lines.zh: 水太深，我这两条腿撑不住。
lines.en: Too deep. These legs can't reach bottom.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀出去，羽毛全散了。
lines.en: The blast threw me. Feathers everywhere.

lines.zh: 有个东西扎在我翅膀上。

lines.en: That light made my legs weak.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的羽毛全立着。
往下掉，翅膀张开了也没用。
